title: Quarter-Hour FPL: Synthesize, Then Decide
tagline: A time-boxed way to play FPL without getting overloaded, for anyone who wants to enjoy it and stay consistent.
subject: Sport

items.name: Set a 15-minute limit
items.why: No more than 15 minutes a week on decisions, otherwise you get overloaded.

items.name: Check the news via a content creator video
items.why: Watch a creator like Let's Talk FPL to get the news.

items.name: Skim Reddit briefly
items.why: A quick look at r/fantasypl to add to what the video said.

items.name: Synthesize everything you've read
items.why: Pull the video and Reddit together instead of following either one blindly.

items.name: Make your own decision
items.why: The final call comes from your own thoughts.

items.name: When the video and Reddit disagree, trust my gut
items.why: It depends how safe or risky I'm feeling at the time.

items.name: Let the moves my team needs set the risk level
items.why: I weigh the options, look at the moves my team needs to make, then settle on a risky or safe move.

sections.title: Level up and keep it fun

items.name: Use yourmicromanager.com
items.why: It's how I actually level up my FPL experience.

items.name: Have fun with it
items.why: Don't give up just because you had a bad week or forgot to make transfers.

briefing.headline: Raya, João Pedro and Thiago have the biggest flags, and most sold players include Cherki, Gvardiol and Raya before the Gameweek 11 deadline.

points.text: Official data shows Raya (47.4% owned) has a shoulder injury with a 75% chance of playing.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: João Pedro (28.4% owned) has a thigh injury with an unknown return date. Chelsea injury news also covers Lacroix and Martinez.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Thiago (6.7% owned) is suspended until 5 December. Hall and Davis have 75% chance of playing flags.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Most bought: Evanilson, Okafor, Tavernier, N.Jackson and Van Hecke. Most sold: Cherki, Gvardiol, Raya, Haaland and João Pedro.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Price rises: Evanilson, Rogers, Trafford and Van Hecke. Price falls: Schuster, M.Sangaré, Oriola, Yohanna and Shepherd. Raya and Wirtz also rise, Mbeumo falls.
